contract: Unknown measurements cannot satisfy applicable hard limits. Actual over-deadline recovery must record failed canonical Work without manufacturing an in-limit output manifest. The full PostgreSQL suite found both a legacy producer omitting known token usage and an overdue advisory Work that could not terminate through the validated output path.
architecture: Output validation and failure transitions serve different purposes. Reject invalid or unmeasured outputs, but permit a canonical failed Work revision with the actual terminal failure and no output manifest. Rehydration must preserve that failure kind. Native Thread and Artifact owners still retain exact error content in the same outer transaction. The normal HTTP readers also require registered-version dispatch rather than fixed legacy schemas.
dependencies: The new stricter Work resource boundary affects existing grounded terminal producers. Their measured model-call token and cost records must populate the existing output usage fields. Update the canonical Work failure transition and PostgreSQL rehydration together, then verify both legacy scientific owner readers and native conversation readers. No QA provider eligibility source changed.
environment: A fresh disposable PostgreSQL 18.6 instance applied and validated all 66 forward migrations. Core 364, adapters 153 and strict contracts 723 checks passed. The full PostgreSQL test harness reported two function failures; the database was disposed by its normal cleanup. No inspection database or user data was reset.
verification: The broader run found failures omitted by the narrower conversation construction checks. Preserve /tmp/petra-w3-postgres.log as failed evidence, retain the ledger failure count, and stop retries after the second failure. Tests must distinguish valid output measurements from failure-only completion and must verify actual HTTP version dispatch, lineage, paging and browser restoration before W03 closes.
changed_remedy: Implement a canonical failure-only transition for worker failure, timeout and resource exhaustion; retain its exact kind during PostgreSQL rehydration. Populate grounded output token/cost measurements from the retained model call. Fix fixed-version HTTP reader validation. Add tests for over-deadline recovery, rehashed copied owners, complete lineage and paged original content, then rerun affected tests and the full PostgreSQL suite before formal paired capture. Keep W03 open.
